According to the information provided in the data tables and sources, there is no specific time mentioned by Turalyon for limiting noisy activities. The discussions among community members revolve around finding ways to cope with and mitigate the noise caused by construction while working on the garden renovation. There are suggestions for quieter working hours and a desire for the administration to consider these concerns. However, no concrete plan or schedule for restricting noisy activities to certain times has been stated or agreed upon in the text provided.

The general conversation indicates a collective hope that the administration will take note of the residents' frustrations and adjust the construction schedule accordingly to reduce the noise impact. Some community members propose community meetings to discuss the issue further and brainstorm solutions. Yet, there is no explicit reference to Turalyon setting a particular time frame for when noisy activities should be limited or for when the garden work should ideally be carried out to minimize disruption.

In summary, while there is evident concern over the noise and suggestions for adjustments, Turalyon and the community have not established a clear time plan for limiting noisy activities as per the provided data. The focus remains on finding a balance and maintaining a positive outlook towards the completion of the garden renovation project.
